summary.text: Tom Louisos is an independent candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously ran for the House of Delegates in District 32 in 2012 and 2014.

paragraphs.text: Louisos earned a B.A. from the University of Chicago and an M.B.A. from West Virginia University.

He ran in the 2012 Democratic primary for West Virginia House of Delegates District 32, finishing fourth among seven candidates in a race for three seats, and in 2014 he ran in the general election for the same district as an independent, receiving 8.8 percent of the vote.
Ballotpedia lists Louisos as married to Trena, with three children.
